title: obsidianmd/obsidian-skills
lede: Obsidian's official Agent Skills teach coding agents to read and write a vault in its own formats, from wikilinks and callouts to Bases and JSON Canvas files.

points: Seven skills: Obsidian Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, the Obsidian CLI, Obsidian Headless, Defuddle and Knap.
They follow the Agent Skills spec, so one set works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode and others.
Obsidian ships them as an official plugin for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok Bot, Hermes and Kiro.
Defuddle turns web pages into clean Markdown to save tokens; Knap renders Markdown templates from JSON or CSV.

points.text: The obsidian-cli skill's base commands don't follow the documented file and path targeting rules.
Users want the skills to read a vault's own Obsidian settings.
